rows.note: Use 即時 as the all-purpose adjective for something that happens right away or is available in real time.

example.traditional: 呢個系統會即時通知你。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 hai6 tung2 wui5 zik1 si4 tung1 zi1 nei5

rows.note: Use 即食 for food that is ready to eat with little or no preparation.

example.english: I don’t have time to cook, so I’ll just eat instant noodles.
example.traditional: 我唔得閒煮飯，食即食麵算啦。
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 dak1 haan4 zyu2 faan6 sik6 zik1 sik6 min6 syun3 laa1

rows.note: Use 即影即有 specifically for instant photographs or cameras that produce a photo immediately.

example.english: This instant camera is really convenient for travelling.
example.traditional: 呢部相機即影即有，去旅行帶住好方便。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 soeng1 gei1 zik1 jing2 zik1 jau5 heoi3 leoi5 hang4 daai3 zyu6 hou2 fong1 bin6

rows.note: Use 短暫 for something that lasts only a short time or is momentary.

example.english: This calm lasted only an instant.
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 ping4 zing6 zi2 hai6 dyun2 zaam6 ge3
